name: playwright
purpose: Anonymous web scraping for ATS job listings (Greenhouse, Ashby, Workday). Fast, low-token, no auth required.
first_use_note: Playwright downloads its browser on first run (~200MB). Subsequent calls are instant.
manual_install: First MCP call triggers browser download. No further config.
alternatives: If you need authenticated browsing too (LinkedIn People tab, in-app DM threads), install browserbase or chrome-devtools-mcp ALONGSIDE playwright — they coexist.
